title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Lemon Mint Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Lemon Mint Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a bright citrus inhale followed by a cool, herbal Mint exhale. The sharp Lemon adds zest and freshness, while the Mint note rounds it off with a smooth, cooling lift. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod. Together they provide up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, eliminating the need for refilling or coil changes. With a built-in 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures consistent flavour and smooth vapour output. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, setup is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to vape.
